item.title: Little Mix’s Leigh-Anne Pinnock Announces Pregnancy: ‘As One Chapter Ends, Another Begins’
item.description:
[Intro music fades out]
Host: Welcome to our latest update! We've got some exciting news to share with you all. Little Mix member and solo artist Leigh-Anne Pinnock is expecting her third child with her husband, professional soccer player Andre Gray.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: Pinnock shared the heartfelt news on her social media with a emotional video. In the clip, she's seen recording her new song "Heaven" in a studio, before revealing her baby bump. The caption reads, "As one chapter ends, another begins."
[Short audio clip of "Heaven" plays]
Host: This new addition to the family comes after Pinnock and Gray, who were married in Jamaica in 2023, welcomed their twin daughters in 2021. Fellow Little Mix members Perrie Edwards and Jade Thirlwall were quick to congratulate Pinnock on the news.
[Short music transition]
Host: This exciting news comes at a great time for Pinnock's music career. She recently released her debut solo album "My Ego Told Me To" and announced a U.K. and European tour. Little Mix, formed in 2011 on The X Factor, has had a successful run with multiple Billboard chart entries, including their albums "DNA", "Salute", and "Glory Days".
[Outro music starts playing]
Host: That's all for now. Congratulations to Leigh-Anne Pinnock and her growing family! We can't wait to see what's next for this talented artist.
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
